From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual roadmap: 8-week evaluation & go-live targets

Hi Sophie —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, I put together a very short mutual roadmap to align on evaluation scope, owners, and a near-term decision target so we can plan Dedicated capacity if it looks like a fit. Attached is a first draft (MAP_Draft_Helio_v1.pdf) — a 1-pager with milestones.

High-level proposal (8-week runway):
- Week 0: 30-min intro sync (AE + champion + SRE/Procurement) to finalize success criteria and security checklist
- Weeks 1–3: Pilot eval — integration, sample traffic, metric collection (latency, token cost, accuracy on curated prompts)
- Weeks 4–5: Performance tuning & quantization pilot (if needed)
- Week 6: Exec readout + decision window
- Week 7–8: If green, schedule Dedicated slot + go-live prep

Who I suggest on our side: myself (AE), Priyom (Solutions Engineer), Logan (Customer Success). Could you confirm the primary champion and whether procurement should be included from the first sync? I also called out a couple of success metrics in the doc — please highlight anything you want changed.

Proposed 30-min slots next week: Tue 10:00–10:30 PT, Wed 11:30–12:00 PT. If none of those work, share two windows that do.

Thanks — looking forward to getting a clear runbook in place.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0184

Thanks Karthik — this looks very clear and helpful. I'm happy to be the champion on our side and will invite our SRE lead (Raj Patel) to the pilot sync. Procurement (cc'd) should join the initial intro so they see the timeline and contract needs.

Two quick asks from my side:
- Add a short acceptance criteria row around inference quality on our de-identified dataset (we can share a 2000-line sample).
- Can the evaluation checklist include a token-cost estimate based on 30k tokens/day?

I can do Tue 10:00 PT. Please send calendar invite and the updated checklist when you have it.
